kernel.integration_rule: The designated integrator reviews and composes kernel/adapter exports; domain producers own persistence. Coordinate shared interfaces before changing them.
kernel.boundary: Kernel packages own the listed cohesive directories; read and command adapters own disjoint domain subdirectories. Builders choose filenames and exports.

shared_domain_rule: Each native action and assistant adapter invokes the same authorized owning domain function. Only domain owner owns mutation/history/revision/receipt/audit/effect intent transaction.
contract_producers: WP-024 managed follow-up persistence/identity kernel before WP-022
WP-046 actual published summary producer before WP-047
WP-015 Person registration protocol then each later consumer
no_new_framework: Static typed manifests plus one composition function. No plugin bus, general policy/workflow engine, source-helper service factory or generic coding agent.
